column1: # The image area's effects (crates/image/kerf-image), written by hand: effect,
# id, category, name, when to use it; then each parameter.

column5: Removes what a mask outlines (a logo, a stray object, a boom) by filling it from the rest of the picture. Draw the mask with mode=none so the picture stays whole for it. The method says how: video for anything that moves. A large area takes seconds a frame.

column7: The mask outlining the area to fill.

object matches texture within the frame, for stills and locked-off shots; smooth blends the area's edges across it, for skies and walls, and is fastest; video takes what the area hides from the frames around it along the motion, and holds still from frame to frame.
Grows the area past the mask, in source pixels, to leave no edge behind.
The size of the patches object compares.
How many frames either side video reads.

column5: A stroke painted with the picture from elsewhere in it, or from another frame. One effect is one stroke, and strokes paint in order, each over what came before. To take out something on a moving shot, keyframe move_x and move_y from a track.

column7: The stroke as fractions of the picture, x across and y down. One point dabs.
How much of the radius is solid before it fades.

Where it paints from, as a fraction of the picture from the stroke. Left at 0 with from_y and from_frame, it finds a place that matches around the stroke; name it on a moving shot so that it holds still.
Paints from this many frames away in the clip, held to its ends: a clean plate of what moved away.
Moves the stroke with the picture.

column5: Takes a blemish out: a stroke with the detail of elsewhere in the picture, and the light and color of where it goes, so that its edge does not show. One effect is one stroke. Parameters as image.clone's.

column7: The stroke as fractions of the picture, x across and y down. One point dabs.
How much of the radius is solid before it fades.

Where it paints from, as a fraction of the picture from the stroke. Left at 0 with from_y and from_frame, it finds a place that matches around the stroke; name it on a moving shot so that it holds still.
Paints from this many frames away in the clip, held to its ends.
Moves the stroke with the picture.

column5: Liquify: drags the picture around with a mesh. What is at a move's first point ends at its last, and what is around follows less the further it is. It does not fold, and the frame's edges stay on the frame.

column7: The moves as fractions of the picture, x across and y down: x,y>x,y, more points to drag through them, and a space between moves.
How far around a move the picture follows.
How far along its moves it has come; animate it to push over time.
Moves the moves with the picture.
